scripts.dev: npm run build:core && concurrently -n core,api,web -c cyan,magenta,blue "npm run dev -w @sampledge/core" "npm run dev -w @sampledge/api" "npm run dev -w @sampledge/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build -w @sampledge/api && npm run build -w @sampledge/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:core && npm run typecheck -w @sampledge/api && npm run typecheck -w @sampledge/web
scripts.db:setup: npm run build:core && npm run db:setup -w @sampledge/api
